facts.fact: The record states the Sudan Family Support Project, approved 8 October 2020 and closed 30 June 2024 with US$181.4 million disbursed of US$760 million committed, had an MIS with a data-sharing platform linked to the National Civil Registry via API and to payment providers; the date used is the approval date, given as the record's published date.
